tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrites, and positive urine culture for >100,000 CFU/mL Klebsiella pneumoniae, indicating a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and mild proteinuria is noted. Low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
